summary: Gate used by the contact/collision system. If the enable flag at this+0x32BC is zero, returns the default value byte_7C9080 immediately. Otherwise reads the velocity value at this+0x3444 and returns true only when it lies in [2, 4] and either the FPU condition flags (C0/C2) are clear or DistanceComparison((float*)this) is false.

local_names.this: vehicle/contact object whose velocity and distance metrics are checked
local_names.v2: velocity value read from this+0x3444 and compared against range [2, 4]
local_names.v4: FPU condition flag C0 left over from a prior float compare
local_names.v5: FPU condition flag C2 left over from a prior float compare

operations.description: If the enable flag at this+0x32BC is zero, skip the check and return the default value byte_7C9080
Read the velocity value at this+0x3444 into v2

When either FPU condition flag (C0/C2) is set, additionally require DistanceComparison((float*)this) to return false
DistanceComparison compares a distance metric using this as a float pointer when the flag test fails
Return the conjunction of the range check and the flag/distance guard; called from sub_49B7A0 and sub_4F0430
